page.overview:
Who is Tesien Jorhald?

Tesien Jorhald was an Aes Sedai of the Red Ajah.

Her name indicates that she was likely from Tarabon as no other names ending in "hald" are from anywhere else (see Geofram Bornhald, Aludra Nendenhald, Androl Genhald, Tazenia Nerenhald).

In traditional Red Ajah custom, she forced Pevara Tazanovni to give up being friends with Seaine Herimon once Pevara was raised to the shawl. This may indicate she was Highest of the Red Ajah at the time, but not necessarily so.
